from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Identify full solid separator rows and columns (the separator color is
    # constant across each such line).
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep_colors = [grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows] + [grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols]
    if not sep_colors:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    sep_color = Counter(sep_colors).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows = [r for r in sep_rows if grid[r][0] == sep_color]
    sep_cols = [c for c in sep_cols if grid[0][c] == sep_color]

    def intervals(n, separators):
        cuts = sorted(separators)
        out, start = [], 0
        for x in cuts:
            if start < x:
                out.append((start, x))
            start = x + 1
        if start < n:
            out.append((start, n))
        return out

    row_blocks = intervals(h, sep_rows)
    col_blocks = intervals(w, sep_cols)
    cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols]
    background = Counter(cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
    panels = [(r0, r1, c0, c1) for r0, r1 in row_blocks for c0, c1 in col_blocks]
    # The panel containing the non-background pattern is the source.
    source = max(panels, key=lambda p: sum(
        grid[r][c] != background
        for r in range(p[0], p[1]) for c in range(p[2], p[3])))
    sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = source
    pattern = [grid[r][sc0:sc1] for r in range(sr0, sr1)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in panels:
        if (r1-r0, c1-c0) != (sr1-sr0, sc1-sc0):
            continue
        for dr in range(r1-r0):
            out[r0+dr][c0:c1] = pattern[dr][:]
    return out
PY
